mode.title: Mode
mode.description: cheapest = plans available at your postcodes, ranked by the estimated annual bill; plans = every matching plan; changes = price changes since a date or your last run; brands = the retailers we cover.

postcodes.title: Postcodes
postcodes.description: Australian postcodes (4 digits, e.g. 2000, 3000, 0800). A plan is returned once with every requested postcode it serves.

fuelTypes.title: Fuel
fuelTypes.description: Electricity, gas, or dual-fuel plans (exact match).

planTypes.title: Plan types
planTypes.description: Market offers, standing offers (default offer) or regulated plans. Empty = all.

brands.title: Retailers
brands.description: Only these retailers: a word of the name ("agl", "origin", "red") or a retailer id from mode "brands".

features.title: Must have
features.description: Keep only plans with all of these. "No demand charges" is on by default because the bill estimate cannot price demand charges; remove it to see those plans too.

annualKwh.title: Electricity use per year (kWh)
annualKwh.description: About 4,000 kWh for a typical 2-3 person home; your bill shows your own.

peakShare.title: Peak share
peakShare.description: Share of your electricity used in peak hours (time-of-use plans). Peak + shoulder + off-peak should be 1.

shoulderShare.title: Shoulder share
shoulderShare.description: Share of your electricity used in shoulder hours (time-of-use plans).

offPeakShare.title: Off-peak share
offPeakShare.description: Share of your electricity used off-peak (time-of-use plans).

solarExportKwh.title: Solar export per year (kWh)
solarExportKwh.description: Electricity your panels send to the grid; credited at the plan's best feed-in tariff.

gasAnnualMj.title: Gas use per year (MJ)
gasAnnualMj.description: For gas plans. Around 25,000 MJ for a home with gas heating and hot water; 0 = no gas estimate.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: How to order the plans. cheapest mode ranks by the estimated annual bill by default.

changedSince.title: Changed since
changedSince.description: Mode "changes": a date (2026-09-01) or "last-run". Empty = last 7 days.

maxAgeHours.title: Max data age (hours)
maxAgeHours.description: We refresh every plan daily. Older data is still served, with a warning in the run summary.

includeRaw.title: Include raw CDR payload
includeRaw.description: Add the plan's original CDR JSON (large).
